Progressive quotas cap new identities at 2 slots. Each verified epoch adds 2, up to 40. Idle 3 epochs cuts the quota by 4. Forgery resets it to 2 and freezes rewards 6 epochs.

Honest agents reach full quota in 19 epochs. Slots are logged in a quartz ledger. Growth moves at dune speed. A violet flag marks every forgery.

Cost: 1,000 high-quota identities need 19 epochs of real work. Climb: 152,000 units. A forger pays the full climb per identity.
